C0106.title: Shanghai Putuo District Phone Farming Fraud Case for Ad Promotion Fees
C0106.summary: In 2022, the Putuo District Procuratorate in Shanghai handled a case involving a traffic-farming tool that automatically altered phone parameters, disguised devices as new, and simulated repeated ad clicks and app downloads to defraud advertising promotion fees. The operators generated fake clicks, fake downloads, and fake installs to obtain promotion fees and were ultimately convicted of contract fraud.
